texts.name: name
texts.text: Practitioner-led technical due diligence from a software engineering company with 20 years of production delivery across 20+ industries. We assess technology from real engineering experience, not from a checklist alone.

texts.name: “I used two different development firms before finally finding MEV. We have a video advertising technology platform -- with over 140 repositories at GitHub -- so it was (and is) a lot of work, but the MEV team has been amazing. They, unlike the other firms, document everything with a clear plan, weekly calls, and they do what they say they will do -- on time and on budget. They also came to me with solutions and creative ideas. Their team is pragmatic, hard working, diligent, and extremely competent. I cannot say enough good things about them.”

texts.name: Solution & Implementation
texts.text: The Impact of an M&A Tech Audit

texts.name: Subheading
texts.text: Operating-cost and cloud-spend analysis gives you the numbers you need to build a realistic post-close budget.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Surface material risks across architecture, code, infrastructure, security, and engineering operations before they become your problem.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: EHR/EMR integrations · Epic, Cerner, athenahealth · HL7 v2, FHIR · Mirth, Rhapsody, Redox · HIE integrations

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Quantify technical debt, infrastructure costs, and the post-close investment needed to maintain, modernize, or scale the technology.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Patient, provider, payer, plan · Entity resolution · ICD, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, NDC · Data quality guardrails · Lineage tracking

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Assess the target against the security, privacy, and compliance requirements relevant to the deal.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Data access layers · Reporting APIs · ETL/ELT pipelines · Snowflake · Middleware · Cloud migration · Error handling & monitoring

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Understand how well the technology can integrate with your systems, data, infrastructure, and workflows.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: HIPAA · SOC 2 · HITRUST · GDPR · RBAC / ReBAC · PHI tokenization · Audit trails · BAAs

texts.name: Solution & Implementation
texts.text: The "Big Four" Alternative for Technical Due Diligence

texts.name: Subheading
texts.text: A comprehensive independent technical assessment doesn’t require a large consulting team or the highest price tag. Often, a small team of senior engineers can move faster, go just as deep, and adapt the assessment to your deal thesis.

texts.name: We have shipped code in .NET, PHP, legacy VB6, and modern cloud stacks. That lets us judge architecture, code quality, and engineering maturity from real delivery experience, not from a checklist alone.

texts.name: Findings you can take into the room. Knowing that modernizing a legacy module will cost roughly $100K and six months gives you the leverage to move on price or on deal structure.

texts.name: Solution & Implementation
texts.text: How Deep We Can Go Depends on Access

texts.name: Subheading
texts.text: The teams that need an independent technical view before committing capital.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Recommended when possible. We review source code and history, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and cost data. This allows us to assess implemented architecture, code quality, technical debt, performance, scalability, dependencies, delivery practices, and other areas directly.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: When code or systems cannot leave your environment, we can work through guided walkthroughs, agreed tools, company-generated analysis, dashboards, and technical evidence.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Useful when direct access is impossible. We can assess intended architecture, roadmap, organization, dependencies, and control design, but areas that cannot be independently verified are clearly identified as such.
